description:
The 40+ built-in LED lights along the deck add a magical glow, making every ride extra exciting for your little one. With its 3-wheel design, the scooter provides excellent stability, helping kids build balance and confidence as they ride.
The non-slip deck ensures stability and safety, keeping little riders secure as they zoom around. Featuring vibrant Paw Patrol characters, it brings fun and excitement to every ride.
Get your little one riding in no time with the easy Quick Connect system. Simply snap the pieces together for a fast, hassle-free setup, so more time can be spent enjoying the adventure.
The PAW Patrol handlebar plaque adds a fun and bold touch, making every ride feel like a rescue mission. With secure flared handles, young riders can maintain a firm grip for a safe and enjoyable adventure.
